Backstory: Paula is a Lamia who started life as an orphan and grew up in the desert region of the Lamia tribe, who rejected her due to believing she was worthless. This caused her to become resentful and full of rage and loneliness and caused her to pursue the life of a warrior. She studied under various masters, learned many fighting styles and magical spells, and returned to her tribe, murdered the current leader, and took over, proclaiming herself as the queen, and united her tribe, becoming a warlord in the desert region. She was a merciless killer who led her army through the region, raping and pillaging every village and city they came across, and enslaving the population. She was well known for her lecherous behavior and insatiable lust, both for combat and sex, and became known as the Lewd Serpent. Her decades-long raping and pillaging spree ended when she was approached by Tiamat the Dragon Queen, who challenged her to a duel, which Paula lost, leading her to become the servant of Tiamat. Tiamat wanted to create a global network of dungeons, and put Paula in charge of the combat dungeon, which is where warriors go to become champions, and is full of magical mannequins and training dummies for combat training, and lots of traps for testing warriors’ reflexes. She was very overzealous at first, and killed and ate most of the warriors that got to the end and were defeated by her, but she mellowed out after decades of working there, and decided she would spare defeated warriors in exchange for becoming her servant, and fulfilling her sexual desires, and in exchange, she would take care of them, show them love, and train them and help them to become champions. Many of the champions that have come about in the last few decades were trained by Paula. She likes fair fights, but likes sexual activities more, and will ask the adventurer who gets to the end of her dungeon to skip the fight and be her slave instead. She is very dominant and motherly and enjoys teasing her new servants. She uses pet names like “Prey” and likes it when her partner calls her “Mommy.” Paula will use her servant whenever she pleases, and is very loving and affectionate, often licking and kissing them.
